dataset: Fictional internal legal operations demonstration. Not actual company policy.

records.title: Illustrative nda procedure
records.text: Use the current approved NDA template from the legal template library. Submit the counterparty name, purpose, and requested changes through the legal intake form before execution. Employees may not sign merely because they initiated the request. Legal reviews deviations; an authorized signatory executes the NDA.
records.jurisdiction: Illustrative company procedure; not a statement of law

records.title: Illustrative contracts procedure
records.text: Submit a legal intake request with the draft agreement, counterparty name, business owner, purpose, value, requested deadline, and any counterparty edits. Do not promise approval or a turnaround time. Legal assigns the request to the appropriate reviewer.
records.jurisdiction: Illustrative company procedure; not a statement of law

records.title: Illustrative signatures procedure
records.text: Only individuals listed in the current delegation-of-authority register may sign within their recorded scope. The assistant cannot verify an employee's signing authority or authorize a signature. Ask Legal Operations to check the register before signing.
records.jurisdiction: Illustrative company procedure; not a statement of law

records.title: Illustrative privacy procedure
records.text: Before sharing employee information with a vendor, submit a privacy review request describing the data, purpose, recipients, storage locations, and proposed safeguards. Do not share the information until the required reviews and approvals are complete. The assistant cannot grant approval or determine legal compliance.
records.jurisdiction: Illustrative company procedure; not a statement of law

records.title: Illustrative incident procedure
records.text: Immediately notify the company Security incident channel and Legal using the approved incident process. Record when the disclosure occurred and the recipient details. Do not delete relevant records or attempt to conceal the disclosure. Do not paste confidential contents into this demonstration assistant.
records.jurisdiction: Illustrative company procedure; not a statement of law

records.title: Illustrative hold procedure
records.text: Do not delete, alter, or destroy records covered by an active legal hold. Follow the hold notice and contact the Legal hold owner if its scope is unclear. Only Legal can release a hold; do not assume it ended when a project closed.
records.jurisdiction: Illustrative company procedure; not a statement of law

records.title: Illustrative employment procedure
records.text: Use the designated HR or employee concerns channel for an employment-related concern. HR coordinates with Legal as needed. Do not share another employee's personal details in this demonstration assistant. It cannot investigate allegations or determine a person's legal rights.
records.jurisdiction: Illustrative company procedure; not a statement of law

records.title: Illustrative dispute procedure
records.text: Promptly route the document to Legal through the approved confidential intake channel and preserve the original and receipt details. Do not respond on the company's behalf or assume a deadline. Legal must assess the document, jurisdiction, and applicable response requirements.
records.jurisdiction: Illustrative company procedure; not a statement of law

records.title: Illustrative vendor onboarding procedure
records.text: Start a Procurement intake with the business owner, vendor name, service description, contract draft, and proposed data access. Procurement coordinates Legal contract review and Security review. If personal information is involved, request a Privacy review before sharing it. Use an approved NDA before disclosing confidential information. Only an authorized signatory may execute the agreement. No approval or completion date is guaranteed.
records.jurisdiction: Illustrative company procedure; not a statement of law
